name: ai-control-tower
description: Read-only access to the AI Control Tower (risk register, agent registry, AI budget), the Sub4Me test customer (sample data) your n8n Cloud automation and the Skill Marketplace (impact, governance, lifecycle, gaps, recommendations). Plus two Sub4Me demo-ticket tools; creating a ticket is the only write and goes to a demo table.

tools.name: get_risks
tools.description: List open AI governance risks, optionally filtered by severity, progress or owner.

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Get one risk by id.

tools.name: get_agent_overview
tools.description: Summary of the AI agent registry.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents (e.g. everything in production) with summary and filters.

tools.name: get_unregistered_assets
tools.description: Unregistered AI assets found by the discovery scan.

tools.name: get_overprivileged_agents
tools.description: Remediation queue for overprivileged agents.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.description: Monthly AI budget by team group with reconciliation.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo service tickets (Supabase).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a Sub4Me demo ticket (the only write; demo table).

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the shared skill registry (approved skills) before building a new skill.

tools.name: get_skill_info
tools.description: Profile of one approved skill from the shared registry (no skill text).

tools.name: list_skill_catalog
tools.description: Skill marketplace overview: counts per board area, LOB, team and reach, with the skills; filterable.

tools.name: get_skill_ranking
tools.description: Top skills by demand (installs, views, search hits), filterable by board area, LOB, team or reach.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo customer's contracts, filter by status (sample data).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Offers SAP made to the Sub4Me demo customer: renewals and new products, filter by type or status (sample data).

tools.name: get_ai_consumption
tools.description: AI-unit consumption of the Sub4Me demo customer with forecast, by product and month, optional product or month filter (sample data).

tools.name: get_customer_overview
tools.description: Everything about the Sub4Me test customer in one answer: master data, contracts, offers, AI units, tickets and highlights (sample data).

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: One Sub4Me product with its contracts, offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: One Sub4Me contract by id with notice deadline, renewal offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One SAP offer to the Sub4Me customer by id with the contract it renews (sample data).

tools.name: search_sub4me
tools.description: Free-text search across Sub4Me products, contracts, offers and tickets.

tools.name: get_n8n_overview
tools.description: n8n Cloud automation overview of the last 14 days: workflows, executions, success rate, categories, needs attention.

tools.name: list_n8n_workflows
tools.description: List n8n workflows with category, trigger, apps and run statistics; filter by text, category, active or failing.

tools.name: get_n8n_workflow
tools.description: One n8n workflow in detail by id or name, with runs per day and latest executions.

tools.name: list_n8n_executions
tools.description: Recent n8n executions, filter by status, workflow or category (no execution contents).

tools.name: list_n8n_categories
tools.description: The categories n8n workflows are sorted into by tag, with their workflows and the uncategorized ones.

tools.name: get_skill_impact
tools.description: Skill impact: runs, success, time saved, value and run cost per skill (sample data).

tools.name: get_skill_governance
tools.description: Skill governance: EU AI Act class, DPIA, reviews due, linked risks and agents (sample data).

tools.name: get_skill_lifecycle
tools.description: Skill lifecycle: change log, dependencies, tests, sunset, deputy; who depends on what (sample data).

tools.name: find_skill_gaps
tools.description: Processes without a skill and skill requests from the teams, with potential hours (sample data).

tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Recommend skills for a role and/or a task with example prompts and demo flow.

tools.name: recommend_skill_workflow
tools.description: Recommend an ordered sequence of marketplace skills for a role and/or a goal, so the person does not need to know every skill. Example: role "Account Manager", goal "Kundentermin und Verlängerung" returns the steps customer-call-prep, renewal-radar, quote-drafter and ticket-writer, each with why, input, output, maturity, risk class and warnings (sunset, replaced, not in the registry). Use it for "In welcher Reihenfolge nutze ich welche Skills …?". Sample playbooks.

tools.name: get_graph_overview
tools.description: Overview of the knowledge graph that connects the Sub4Me customer (contracts, offers, products, tickets), the Skill Marketplace (skills, tools), the Control Tower (risks, agent families) and n8n (workflows, apps): counts by node and relation type, the best-connected nodes and nodes without connections. Use it first to see what the graph contains. Sample data.

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Find nodes in the knowledge graph by name or text, optionally of one type (customer, contract, offer, product, family, ticket, skill, tool, risk, agent, workflow, app, person, system, connector). Returns ids to use with the other graph tools. Sample data.

tools.name: get_graph_neighbors
tools.description: One node of the knowledge graph with its direct connections, grouped by node type and written as sentences ("Offer OFF-2026-0318 renews Contract C-2023-0390"). Give the node as id or name (for example "C-2023-0390", "renewal-radar", "R2"). Optionally only neighbours of one type. Sample data.

tools.name: find_graph_path
tools.description: Shortest connection between two nodes of the knowledge graph, step by step with the relation on each step. Answers "Wie hängt Risiko R2 mit dem Kunden zusammen?" or "Wie ist der Ariba-Vertrag mit dem Skill renewal-radar verbunden?". Sample data.

tools.name: analyze_graph_impact
tools.description: Impact analysis: everything connected to a node within a number of steps, grouped by distance and node type, with the route to each. Answers "Was ist betroffen, wenn der Ariba-Vertrag nicht verlängert wird?" or "Was hängt an Risiko R2?". Hubs such as the connector and the systems are not followed, so the result stays about business relations. Sample data.

tools.name: get_skill_ratings
tools.description: Star ratings of marketplace skills (1 to 5, anonymous, one rating per person). Without a name: ranking of all skills by a damped average (a skill with two five-star votes does not beat one with 40 votes at 4.6); skills with fewer than 5 ratings are marked "new". With a name: average, number of ratings, how many gave 1 to 5 stars, and the latest comments. Answers "Welche Skills sind am besten bewertet?" or "Wie wird ticket-writer bewertet?". Live from Supabase when connected, otherwise sample data.

tools.name: rate_skill
tools.description: Rate a published marketplace skill with 1 to 5 stars and an optional short comment (max 280 characters). One rating per person and skill; rating again replaces the earlier one. Ask the person for the stars first and repeat skill, stars and comment back before calling; never rate on your own. Do not put names, customer data or secrets into the comment. Needs the Supabase connection; sample skills cannot be rated.

tools.name: enrich_ticket
tools.description: Enrich one Sub4Me service ticket with AI Control Tower context: contracts and AI-unit consumption of the product, other open tickets, related agents, risks with owner and mitigation, teams over budget, and next steps. Read-only; the links are a heuristic over sample data.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

n8n_url.title: n8n Cloud address
n8n_url.description: Optional. Example: https://firma.app.n8n.cloud. Needed for the n8n questions in the chat.

n8n_api_key.title: n8n API key
n8n_api_key.description: Optional. Created in n8n under Settings, n8n API. Read access to workflows and executions. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.
